name: Manga
traits: black ink on white paper, no colour
dot and gradient screentones for midtones and shadows
panel-like framing with hard borders and dramatic crops
strong contrast with solid black fills and hatching
bestFor: a turn told in a few bold frames
suits: products with a strong shape that read without colour (bottles, tools, gadgets, shoes); bold, dramatic or ironic brands
stylePara: Black-and-white Japanese manga page come to life: crisp black ink lines with pen pressure, thick contours and fine inner hatching; midtones and shadows are mechanical dot screentones and gradient tones, with solid black fills for hair and deep shadow; pure white paper highlights; strong contrast and graphic composition; frames feel like single manga panels with hard edges, dramatic crops and occasional focus lines radiating toward the subject; faint paper texture and print grain; no colour anywhere, no grey airbrush, no 3D.

rendering.line: G-pen style ink line with strong pressure variation; dense parallel and cross hatching for texture and shadow
rendering.shading: dot screentone and gradient tone patches with hard cut edges; solid black for deep shadows and hair
rendering.colour: none: pure black, white and screentone greys; the product reads by shape and tone only (or, as a deliberate choice, as the only spot colour in the frame)
rendering.texture: visible screentone dots, slight paper fibre, faint print misregistration
rendering.lighting: graphic: light shown by white paper and tone placement, strong backlight silhouettes for drama

motion: Mostly held panels with minimal motion, like a motion comic: one element moves at a time (hair, an eye, a hand, falling tone flecks), tones and focus lines pulse on beats; actions jump between strong poses on threes or fours; occasional fast push into a new panel crop.
camera: Panel grammar: extreme close-ups on eyes and hands, tilted dramatic angles, slow push-in on a still panel, a hard cut to a new panel framing; a slide from one panel to the next like reading a page; no smooth orbit.
avoid: any colour or sepia tint creeping in
soft grey airbrush shading instead of screentone
screentone dots crawling or boiling between frames
sheets: Each character sheet is an inked black-and-white turnaround (front, three-quarter, side) with the exact screentone placement on hair and clothes noted, plus two expressions; the product is inked as a crisp prop with its silhouette and label area exact, tone placement fixed; places are inked background panels.
risk: Video models dislike pure black-and-white and slowly add colour or soft grey shading, and screentones shimmer or crawl when the camera moves; keep the camera mostly locked and repeat 'black ink and screentone only, no colour'. The product loses its colour cue, so either rely on its silhouette or decide on a single spot-colour rule at the sheet stage and keep it in every shot. Seedance may add speech balloons or sound-effect lettering; forbid them in NO TEXT.

example.prompt: Black-and-white manga panel: a woman in her thirties with a dark bun drawn in solid black ink and a top shaded in mid-grey screentone (her orange top rendered as tone), holds a small glass bottle with a pale cap close to the camera, the glass shown with white highlights and gradient tone; behind her a sunny kitchen inked with fine hatching, white sunlight across the counter, and a droopy fern on the windowsill in drooping inked fronds; strong contrast, dot screentones, faint focus lines toward the bottle, paper grain. Vertical 9:16. No text.
